positive_snippets:
🌟 Fantastic Stay at Ahuja Residency SAGE, Delhi!!!!
I stayed at Ahuja Residency SAGE for two months on an official assignment, and it was an exceptional experience. The property is a refined 4-star stay located in a posh, peaceful area, perfect for an extended visit.
The staff is outstanding—warm, attentive, and always ready to help. A special mention to Rahul, whose support and professionalism made the stay even smoother. The housekeeping team is excellent, keeping the rooms consistently spotless and comfortable. The food was absolutely yummy, adding a delightful homely touch.
Overall, Ahuja Residency SAGE offers top-notch comfort, impeccable service, and genuine hospitality. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Delhi.

I had booked Ahuja Residency, Delhi for my uncle and aunt during their visit to the city, as my cousin studies nearby. Their experience was wonderful right from the moment they checked in. They were greeted warmly, and the staff maintained a polite and courteous attitude throughout the stay.

The room was clean, well-maintained, and equipped with all modern amenities. The food quality exceeded expectations — every à la carte meal was delicious, and the breakfast spread offered an impressive variety, especially the fresh breads.

Overall, it turned out to be a truly memorable stay for them. Thank you, Ahuja Residency, for your extended support and hospitality. Highly recommended!

Had a very pleasant stay here. The room was tidy, comfortable, and well-maintained. The breakfast spread by Chef Tari was delicious with plenty of options. The overall service was excellent, well managed by Mr. Satish, staff behaviour was good. It is a great, reliable choice in the area
negative_snippets: Stayed for three nights on business. Pros: The room was clean, and the bed was comfortable. It had been newly renovated. The security guard was kind. Laundry service was very efficient. Cons: I'm not sure if the walls are thin, but in my room, I could hear not only the voices from the next room but even the click of switches. Also, the sound of the steel staircase used by staff echoed quite loudly and frequently. Breakfast was basic with not many choices. Personally, I didn't have a very good impression of the receptionist, as they were not very helpful.
